gloss: to brush (hair, clothes, teeth, etc.); to apply a brush to

definitions.gloss: to brush (hair, clothes, a surface); to give (something) a brushing
definitions.explanation: A verb phrase meaning to apply a brush to something — most commonly one's hair, clothes, pets, or shoes. The combination of ブラシ (brush) with かける ('to apply, to run over') expresses the action of using a brush in one smooth movement across a surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける。
⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかけた。
examples.english: I brushed my suit before going out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧{気持|きも}ちよさそうにして⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: When I brush the dog's belly, he looks really happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{革|かわ}{靴|ぐつ}→革靴：15433_kawagutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{履|は}いた→履く：00700_haku⟧あと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{柔|やわ}らかい→柔らかい：01096_yawarakai⟧ブラシをかけて、ほこり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}として→落とす：01246_otosu⟧おく⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{長持|ながも}ち→長持ち：14474_nagamochi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Leather shoes will last longer if you brush them with a soft brush to remove dust after wearing them.

notes:
An idiomatic combination of ⟦ブラシ→ブラシ：01503_burashi⟧ (brush) with ⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧, one of the most productive Japanese verbs for 'applying' a tool, substance, or action to an object (compare ⟦アイロン→アイロン：05071_airon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ 'to iron', ⟦{掃除機|そうじき}→掃除機：04967_soujiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ 'to vacuum', ⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ 'to wax').

USAGE:
The particle pattern is ⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ / ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ブラシをかける. Japanese tends to use ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ for the item being brushed (the location or target of the brushing), mirroring the pattern of other かける expressions: ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける, ⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける. Use ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ is also possible for the brushed item when it is treated as a direct object (more common with ほこり 'dust' in the sense of brushing dust off, e.g., ほこり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ブラシ→ブラシ：01503_burashi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける: to brush one's hair
- ⟦{服|ふく}→服：00695_fuku⟧ / ⟦スーツ→スーツ：01367_suutsu⟧ / ⟦コート→コート：01358_kooto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける: to brush clothes
- ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧/⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける: to brush a dog / cat
- ⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ブラシをかける: to brush shoes
- ⟦{軽|かる}く→軽い：00785_karui⟧ブラシをかける: to give a light brushing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish; to brush (teeth) — ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ is the standard way to say 'brush one's teeth', not ブラシをかける
- ブラッシング⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to brush (especially hair or a pet) — a more casual loanword verb, often used in beauty and pet-care contexts
- ⟦{櫛|くし}→櫛：03882_kushi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧とく: to comb — with a comb rather than a brush
- ほこり⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to brush off / dust off — emphasizes removing dust rather than the act of brushing itself
